topography.project_purpose: Liquid Staking. Structurally: 35 project-authored contract(s) across 3 chain(s); 2 ERC20 tokens; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 8 functional families. Its contracts share 5 common project-authored base contract(s) (ownableupgradeable, contextupgradeable, eip712). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
